title: Amazon moves to build a massively polluting gas plant for one data center - TCR 08/09/26
description:
Amazon's planned West Texas data center would run on a private, off-grid gas plant permitted to release 33 million tons of CO2 a year - an amount that, if fully emitted, would exceed the annual emissions of any US coal plant, The Financial Times reports that ByteDance began pre-training an open model with up to 10 trillion parameters, and Rippling built a console to meter AI spending after tokens hit 40% of its R&D payroll.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-9-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:45 Amazon's West Texas gas-plant data center
3:59 ByteDance's 10-trillion-parameter open model
5:53 Companies start metering their AI bill
8:49 Intracranial CAR-T reaches recurrent glioblastoma
12:00 Close

This episode covers the Amazon Pecos County gas-plant permit and data-center emissions, ByteDance's reported model with up to 10 trillion parameters and export-control scale, Rippling's AI Spend Console and Airbnb's 60% faster launches, DeepSeek's signaled price hike, intracranial CAR-T for recurrent glioblastoma, and concentrated sunlight generating entangled photons.

The day's spine is a single trade repeating across carbon, tokens, and light: a scarce, hidden, or hoardable input giving way to an abundant, counted, ambient one. Amazon's Pecos County permit collapses years of diffuse compute emissions into one number with one company's name on it, landing in a rural county with the least standing to refuse. Inside the firms buying compute, Rippling metered its own token bill after it neared 40% of R&D payroll and found an open model 85% cheaper for near-identical output on a particular workload, while Airbnb reported AI cut concept-to-launch time by 60%. The Financial Times reports that ByteDance is pre-training an open model with up to 10 trillion parameters, past the scale export controls were built to fence off, DeepSeek's price hike shows the race downward has a floor, and in physics concentrated sunlight generated entangled photon pairs at 94% fidelity with no laser as intracranial CAR-T survived 72 infusions against recurrent glioblastoma with no dose-limiting toxicity.
